friendly_name: Slice B: real packs register as they are
purpose_context: Every open-packs pack is refused today over its documentation files and org-charter.yaml. This mission makes README.md the pack's one held document with a served /doc read, retires pack.md, PROVENANCE.md and org-charter.yaml by named refusal (org enforcement becomes an activation preset), lets readers ride out the commit swap window, and rewords the text content-form comment, so core can register and use real packs.
purpose_tldr: A real open-packs pack registers through POST/PUT /packs without hand edits.
